selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent TCP/9000 policy and SSH access
selected_evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent rules persisted; node2 reached port 9000, node3 was rejected, both reached SSH, and firewalld remained active.
Node1 remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.
Boot ID changed from 03273aa8… to dc811ed8…; system, SSH, firewalld, persistent rules, and traffic policy recovered.
Boot ID changed from 21972395… to bc185d46…; address and SSH recovered with zero failed units.
Boot ID changed from 22045032… to a9beb389…; address and SSH recovered with zero failed units.
